info.description: API for tracking soda machine inventory, dispenses, restocks, and alerts.
info.title: SodaTracker API

get.description: When a slot, or the whole machine, registering nothing raises an alert

put.description: quietSlotCans: alert when a stocked slot registers nothing while the other slots dispense this many cans (0 = off). quietMachineHours: alert when no slot registers anything for this many hours while the Pi agent is online (0 = off). quietMachineWeekdaysOnly counts only Monday–Friday hours in timezone.

get.description: Local snapshots, the last push to the backup repo, and whether the backup is stale

post.description: Takes a snapshot, prunes old ones, and pushes it to the backup repo when one is configured

put.description: Sets the GitHub repo and token snapshots are pushed to, the snapshot interval (0 = off) and how many local snapshots to keep. Omit token to keep the stored one, or send "" to clear it. A new repo or token is checked against GitHub before it's saved. The token is never returned.

get.description: Returns a fresh gzipped SQLite snapshot of the whole database. It isn't kept or pushed.
Returns the total cost of dispenses for a machine over a time period

delete.description: Deletes all data from the database and re-seeds the admin user

get.description: Whether the alert webhook and the Socket Mode app token are set, and the /soda connection's state. The secrets are never returned.

put.description: Sets the incoming webhook URL (alerts) and the app-level token (/soda over Socket Mode). Omit a field to keep it, or send "" to clear it. Changes apply at once.

post.description: Posts a test message to the configured webhook

get.description: Returns aggregated dispense stats including time series, top products, and cost totals

post.description: The Pi agent calls this every 30s so dashboards can show when it goes offline.

delete.description: Deletes an alert configuration by ID

get.description: Dispense volume over time with a moving-average trend, a weekday-by-hour heatmap, and weekday vs weekend rates. The window's start is clamped to when tracking began.

parameters.description: IANA timezone for buckets and hours (default: UTC)
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: day, week or month (default: from window length)
parameters.name: bucket

get.description: Records and habits: average and record first/last can of the day, busiest day and hour, soda, caffeine and aluminum totals, and which product is dispensed first each day.

parameters.description: IANA timezone for days and hours (default: UTC)
parameters.name: tz

get.description: Stock levels over time rebuilt from restocks and dispenses, hours each slot sat empty, restock intervals, and the share of restocked cans dispensed before the next restock.

parameters.description: IANA timezone for buckets and hours (default: UTC)
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: day, week or month (default: from window length)
parameters.name: bucket

get.description: Product ranking and share with the previous window's rank, per-bucket counts by product, and counts by part of day. Products in a slot appear even with no dispenses.

parameters.description: IANA timezone for buckets and hours (default: UTC)
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: day, week or month (default: from window length)
parameters.name: bucket

get.description: Spend per bucket with a running total, spend by product, the previous window's total, and a projected monthly figure.

parameters.description: IANA timezone for buckets and hours (default: UTC)
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: day, week or month (default: from window length)
parameters.name: bucket

get.description: Hours the Pi agent was heartbeating (online), silent (offline: dispenses not counted) or not yet tracked, per bucket and in total, with the list of outages.

parameters.description: day, week or month (default: from window length)
parameters.name: bucket

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token
Records a soda dispense from the Pi agent. Auto-resolves productId from slot config if not provided.

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream of dispense, stock alert, restock and agent events. Each event's data is the bus event JSON, including machineId. A JWT stream ends when the token expires.
Returns API health status and the running release version

post.description: Handles /soda slash commands. Authenticated by Slack's request signature, not by API key or JWT.

get.description: Returns all registered soda machines

post.description: Creates or updates a soda machine (upsert by ID)

delete.description: Deletes a machine and all associated data (slots, dispenses, restocks, alerts)

get.description: Returns alert events for a machine with optional active-only filter
Returns all alert configurations for a machine

post.description: Creates an alert threshold config for a machine. SlotPosition 0 = machine-wide default. LowThreshold -1 = use slot's own threshold.

get.description: Returns recent dispenses for a machine with optional time and limit filters
Computes estimated days until stock-out for each slot based on recent dispense rate

parameters.description: Days of dispense history to analyze (default 14)
parameters.name: lookbackDays

post.description: Records a restock event for a machine. Clears active alerts for restocked slots.

get.description: Returns recent restocks for a machine

post.description: Destructive replace of all slots for a machine. Deletes existing slots and inserts the new set.

get.description: Returns computed stock status for every slot in a machine
Returns all registered products

post.description: Creates or updates a product (upsert by ID)

delete.description: Deletes a product by ID. Fails with 409 if a slot still holds the product.

get.description: Exports dispense history as CSV or PDF

parameters.description: Export format: csv or pdf (default: csv)
parameters.name: format

snapshots.description: Snapshots are the local snapshots, newest first.

stale.description:
Stale means the last snapshot or push failed, or the last push is
older than StaleAfter.

tokenSet.description:
TokenSet says whether a token is stored. The token itself is never
returned.

color.description:
Color is a "#rrggbb" hex used for the product's dot and chart series.
Empty means the dashboard picks one from its default palette.

sizeOz.description:
SizeOz is the can's volume in US fluid ounces; createProduct defaults
it to 12. CaffeineMg is per can; 0 for caffeine-free or unknown.

trackingSince.description:
TrackingSince is the machine's first dispense or restock, ever; null
with neither. Clients use it to tell a quiet range from one before
tracking began.

peakHour.description: PeakHour is the local hour (0-23) with the most dispenses, -1 if none.

previousTotal.description:
PreviousTotal is the count for the preceding window of the same length,
or null when tracking did not cover all of it.

trend.description: Trend is the trailing moving average (7 days, 4 weeks or 3 months).

counts.description: Counts maps productId to dispenses in this part of the day.

aluminumLb.description: AluminumLb is the cans' aluminum, as if every one is recycled.

firstCanProducts.description:
FirstCanProducts and LastCanProducts count days by the product of
their first and last can. LunchProducts counts cans dispensed from
LunchStartHour to LunchEndHour, local time.

ounces.description: Totals for the window, from each product's can size and caffeine.

avgRestockIntervalDays.description: AvgRestockIntervalDays is null with fewer than two restocks.

untrackedDispenses.description:
UntrackedDispenses counts dispenses recorded while computed stock was
already zero: the slot held more cans than the last restock logged.

usedShare.description:
UsedShare is the share of cans restocked in the window that were
dispensed before that slot's next restock. Null with no restocks.

ongoing.description: Ongoing means the agent is still offline; To is the end of the window.

counts.description: Counts maps productId to dispenses in the bucket.

rank.description:
Rank is 1-based by count. PreviousRank is null when the product had no
dispenses in the preceding window (or tracking did not cover all of it).

quietMachineHours.description:
MachineHours: alert when no slot registers anything for this many
hours while the Pi agent is online.

quietMachineWeekdaysOnly.description:
WeekdaysOnly counts only Monday–Friday hours toward MachineHours, so
a quiet weekend doesn't alert.

quietSlotCans.description:
SlotCans: alert when a stocked slot registers nothing while the other
slots dispense this many cans.

timezone.description: Timezone (IANA) decides where weekends start and end.

currentStock.description: CurrentStock is null when the slot has never been restocked.

lowThreshold.description:
LowThreshold is the slot's own low-stock level (alert configs can
override it for alerting, but not here).

previousTotal.description:
PreviousTotal is spend in the preceding window of the same length, or
null when tracking did not cover all of it.

restockedValue.description:
RestockedValue prices the cans restocked in the window at each slot's
current product cost.

unpricedDispenses.description:
UnpricedDispenses counts dispenses whose product has no cost set; they
add nothing to the totals.

levels.description:
Levels maps slot position to stock at the end of the bucket, or null
when the slot had not been restocked yet.

outageList.description: OutageList is newest first, at most 50.

trackingSince.description: TrackingSince is the agent's first recorded heartbeat, ever.

uptime.description: Uptime is online / (online + offline); null when nothing was tracked.

commands.description:
Commands is the Socket Mode connection: off, connecting, connected
or error (with CommandsError).
